<h2>Combine sjSDM Tuning Work Items</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Combines granular candidate/fold results into the established tuning table
and fold-organized compact prediction cache.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>aggregate_sjsdm_tuning_work_items(list_work_item_results = NULL)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_work_item_results">list_work_item_results</code></td>
<td>
<p>List of results from [run_sjsdm_tuning_work_item()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with 'data_tuning' and 'list_prediction_cache', matching the rich
return contract of [run_sjsdm_tuning_candidates()].
</p>

</main>
